value.account:
CHANGED
- orchestrator/state.py: optional RunState.result_persistence_profile (omitted from to_dict when absent; ValueError naming the profile on construction, initialize() and load, and load leaves the file untouched). A DerivedPureVisitMixin on StateManager and on the call-frame manager supplies begin_eligible_pure_visit, reuse_interrupted_eligible_pure_visit, settle_eligible_pure_success and settle_eligible_pure_failure, each one state write.
- New orchestrator/workflow/pure_result_replay.py (constants, PureResultReplayIndexError, witness, shell build/validate, classify_pure_replay_progress, index derivation, _propagate_pure_ineligibility), pure_replay_literals.py (typed binding-document check), pure_replay_runtime.py (PureReplayRuntime, re-exported lazily from pure_result_replay), pure_replay_coordinator.py (executor wiring).
- executor.py: eligible pure nodes begin/settle through the coordinator, skip start_step, output bundle and publication, and keep the full result in memory. Resume audits conflicts and progress before the prologue, re-derives needed values after the restart boundary, and applies them to in-memory steps after the default-resume decision. The restart node is determined once (cached) and passed to ResumePlanner.determine_default_resume_decision(restart_node_id=...). The provider observation manager is created at execute() start and closed once. outcomes.py gained eligible_pure_settlement. steps/pure_projection.py gained derived=True (no bundle I/O).
- calls.py and call_frame_state.py: fresh non-iterative child frame selects the profile from the callee's frontend_kind; load_existing_call_frame_read_only; a malformed existing frame is rejected ('existing call-frame state') before any write. CLI run and resume --force-restart select the profile for .orc roots.
- Checkpoints: eligible pure points emit no record; restore payload capture omits bindings whose producer is an eligible pure node; default resume filters eligible points before nearest-boundary selection and admits the single zero-record VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY case, otherwise FAIL_CLOSED with lexical_default_resume_prior_boundary_not_restorable.
- specs/state.md section; tests/test_pure_result_replay.py (35 tests, incl. CLI run/force-restart, child-frame selection, end-to-end interrupted resume, durable_input_* and conflict failures, default-resume zero-record case, single restart-boundary call). I changed 2 assertions in tests/test_provider_observation_workflow.py that encoded construction-time manager creation, which the task reverses.

VERIFICATION: full suite 139 failures; 138 fail identically on the stashed baseline (provider isolation, docker, nanobragg, tmux, socket path, golden checks), the 1 regression (a test building the executor with object.__new__) is fixed by making executor.pure_replay a lazy property. I also ran a real CLI run and a hand-interrupted resume of an .orc; the materialized view digest matched the re-derived value.

ALTERNATIVES: persisting the pure values under a different key (rejected: still stores derived data); merging replayed rows into state before default resume (failed: the progress classifier then saw value rows, so the overlay is applied after the decision); one big module (split to stay near 500 lines).

NOT COVERED / CAVEATS
- Union transient-row validation (_expected_names) is untested against a real union pure node; it assumes projection metadata field_role 'discriminant'/'variant' and 'return__variant'.
- Direct tests are missing for profile_conflict surfaces pure_bundle, private_artifact_versions, checkpoint_record and restore_payload (only 'steps' and the visit-two progress failure are tested), for replay inside a call-frame scope, and for the shell-omission payload path beyond the e2e run.
- required_node_ids_for_boundary finds consumers by walking dataclasses and regex-scanning ref strings, so it may over-include nodes; 'durable owner' in the zero-record rule is interpreted as: only bound-input leaves for required pure nodes plus valid profile/progress witnesses.
- Resuming a durable failed/skipped eligible pure row fails closed (no second visit) instead of retrying. Eligibility requires frontend_kind == 'workflow_lisp'; the scope check treats a bundle as 'root' when every node id is root-prefixed. Iteration-owned child frames are detected by runtime_step_id/scope being set in execute_call.
- Nothing committed; no new dependencies.
value.summary: Added the derived_pure_replay.v1 profile: a profile selector in state and the CLI, a replay index and runtime, value-free pure shells with atomic visit transactions, resume-time in-memory re-derivation, and checkpoint/default-resume integration, with tests and a specs/state.md section.

value.account: Reviewed the working tree against every requirement: selector/state, index, shell/visit transactions, replay runtime, durable surfaces, importable names and the specs/state.md section were already present and the 35 existing tests passed. Changes: (1) pure_replay_runtime.audit_persisted_surfaces now matches lineage entries whose producer is either the node's step_id or its node_id (the dataflow ledger writes the runtime step id as producer); (2) added tests for profile_conflict surfaces private_artifact_versions and pure_bundle (the latter by binding the write-root input to an existing file). 37 tests in tests/test_pure_result_replay.py pass; the state/checkpoint/resume/call_frame subset of the suite (1447 passed) has 3 failures, all of which also fail on the stashed baseline (checkpoint identity comparison, procedure-first migration golden). Alternatives from the prior attempt stand: persisting values under another key (still stores derived data), merging replayed rows before default resume (broke the progress classifier), one big module (split to stay near 500 lines). Not covered: union transient-row validation (_expected_names) is untested against a real union pure node and assumes projection field_role discriminant/variant metadata; no direct tests for checkpoint_record/restore_payload conflicts, replay inside a call-frame scope, or the shell-omission payload path beyond the e2e run; required_node_ids_for_boundary may over-include nodes; a durable failed/skipped eligible pure row fails closed on resume rather than retrying; nothing committed.
